description_en: You can invoke GetHistoricalInstanceReport to obtain the historical data report for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用GetHistoricalInstanceReport获取指定实例的历史数据报表
name: GetHistoricalInstanceReport

parameters.help_en: The start time of the Historical Data to retrieve, in UNIX timestamp format with millisecond precision. This parameter is optional. The default value is 00:00:00 of the current day. The earliest allowed time is 180 days before the current time. The time precision for statistics is hourly, snapped to the previous full hour, and the interval is closed
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的起始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，最早为当前时间往前180天，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the Historical Data to retrieve, in UNIX timestamp format with millisecond precision. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. The time precision for statistics is hourly, snapped to the next full hour, and the interval is open. For example, if the start time is 11:12:20 and the end time is 11:45:50, the snapped input parameter Time Range becomes [11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 获取的历史数据的终止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当前时间，统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Media Type. The default value is Audio. Other valid values include Chat and Video
parameters.help_zh: 媒体类型，默认是语音(Audio), 其他可选参数包括Chat和Video
parameters.name: media_type

AbandonRate.description_en: Abandon rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandoned / CallsOffered (because abandonment events and assignment events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
AbandonRate.description_zh: 放弃率。计算公式为：CallsAbandoned/CallsOffered（由于放弃事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageAbandonTime.description_en: Average abandon time, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalAbandonTime / CallsAbandoned
AverageAbandonTime.description_zh: 平均放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonTime/CallsAbandoned

AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: Average IVR abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInIVRTime / CallsAbandonedInIVR
AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description_zh: 平均IVR放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInIVRTime/CallsAbandonedInIVR

AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 平均排队放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInQueueTime/CallsAbandonedInQueue

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Average ring-time abandon duration, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime / CallsAbandonedInRing
AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInRingTime/CallsAbandonedInRing

AverageFirstResponseTime.description_en: Average first response time for chat sessions, in seconds
AverageFirstResponseTime.description_zh: Chat会话平均首次响应时长，单位为秒

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageResponseTime.description_en: Average response time (RT) for chat sessions

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled

AverageWaitTime.description_zh: 平均等待时长，平均每通电话的坐席接起前等待时长。计算公式为： TotalWaitTime/CallsHandled

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled

CallsAbandoned.description_en: Total number of abandoned calls. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandonedInIVR + CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing

CallsAbandonedInIVR.description_en: Number of calls abandoned in IVR, which refers to the count of calls where the customer hung up during the IVR flow after entering it. This is determined by the hang-up reason in call details being marked as "IVR abandoned."
CallsAbandonedInIVR.description_zh: IVR放弃量，即电话进入IVR流程之后在IVR环节客户挂机的数量，判断依据为通话详情的挂断原因为IVR放弃

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_en: Number of calls abandoned in queue, which refers to the number of calls where the customer hung up while waiting in the queue after the call entered the queue
CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_zh: 队列放弃量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInRing.description_en: Number of calls abandoned during ringing, which refers to the quantity of calls where the customer hung up while the agent's phone was ringing
CallsAbandonedInRing.description_zh: 振铃放弃量，即坐席振铃过程中发生客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description_en: Number of calls abandoned in the Intelligent Voice Navigator module
CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description_zh: 通话在智能导航模块放弃的数量

CallsAttendedTransferred.description_en: Number of consultative transfers, which refers to the number of calls that were transferred via consultative transfer. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsAttendedTransferred.description_zh: 咨询转接量，即发生咨询转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsBlindTransferred.description_en: The number of blind transfers, which refers to the count of calls directly transferred without consultation. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsBlindTransferred.description_zh: 直接转接量，即发生直接转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsCausedIVRException.description_en: Number of calls that caused IVR exceptions

CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description_en: Number of calls forwarded to an external number
CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description_zh: 发生转外线的通话数量

CallsHandled.description_en: Acknowledgement count, which refers to the number of calls answered by agents. If a single call is answered by multiple agents, it is counted only once
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即被坐席应答的通话数量，若一通电话被多个坐席应答，只算一次

CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。若一通电话保持多次，算一次

CallsIVRException.description_en: Number of calls with IVR exceptions. A call is counted when the IVR enters a hang-up reason node and the hang-up reason configured in that node is "transfer to agent failed."
CallsIVRException.description_zh: 发生IVR异常的通话数量，判定条件是IVR进入了挂机原因节点且挂机原因节点设置的挂机原因为转人工失败，此时计数加1

CallsOffered.description_zh: 呼入到云联络中心的电话数量

CallsQueued.description_en: Number of calls entering the queue. If a single call enters the queue multiple times, it is counted once
CallsQueued.description_zh: 进入队列的电话数量，若一通电话多次进入队列，算一次

CallsQueuingFailed.description_en: The number of queue failures, which refers to the count of calls where the customer hung up while waiting in the queue after entering it
CallsQueuingFailed.description_zh: 队列失败量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsQueuingOverflow.description_en: The number of calls that overflowed from the queue, where queue overflow refers to calls exceeding the queue capacity while waiting in the IVR queue
CallsQueuingOverflow.description_zh: 队列溢出的通话数量，队列溢出指通话在IVR排队时队列溢出

CallsQueuingTimeout.description_en: Number of calls that timed out during the queuing phase
CallsQueuingTimeout.description_zh: 在排队阶段超时的通话数量

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang agents. If a single call is assigned to multiple agents and rings, it is counted once
CallsRinged.description_zh: 座席振铃的电话数量，若一通电话分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

CallsToVoicemail.description_en: The number of calls routed to voicemail
CallsToVoicemail.description_zh: 进入语音信箱的电话数量

CallsVoicemail.description_en: Number of calls transferred to voicemail. The count increases by 1 when a call enters the voicemail module configured in IVR
CallsVoicemail.description_zh: 转语音信箱的通话数量，当通话进入了IVR中配置的语音信箱模块，计数加1

HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled/CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

MaxAbandonTime.description_en: Maximum abandon time, in seconds. A call is considered abandoned if the customer hangs up after entering the IVR but before an agent answers
MaxAbandonTime.description_zh: 最大放弃时长，单位秒。放弃的定义是通话进入IVR后，坐席接起前，客户发起挂机

MaxAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: Maximum IVR abandonment duration, in seconds. IVR abandonment is defined as a customer hanging up during IVR interaction. This does not include hang-ups while waiting in queue or during agent ringing after call assignment
MaxAbandonedInIVRTime.description_zh: 最大IVR放弃时长，单位秒。IVR放弃的定义是客户在IVR交互过程中挂机，不包括排队状态下客户挂机，不包括通话分配坐席后坐席振铃过程中客户挂机

MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Maximum queue abandonment duration, in seconds
MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 最大排队放弃时长，单位秒

MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Maximum ringing abandonment duration, in seconds. Ringing abandonment is defined as the customer hanging up while the call is ringing on the agent's side after being assigned to the agent
MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 最大振铃放弃时长，单位秒。振铃放弃的定义是通话分配到坐席后，坐席正在振铃，此时客户挂机

MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

ServiceLevel20.description_en: Service level within 20 seconds: number of calls with wait time less than or equal to 20 seconds divided by CallsQueued
ServiceLevel20.description_zh: 20S服务水平，等待时长小于等于20秒的电话数量/CallsQueued

TotalAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: Total IVR abandonment duration, in seconds

TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Total queue abandon time, in seconds
TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 总排队放弃时长，单位秒

TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 总振铃放弃时长，单位秒

TotalHoldTime.description_en: Total call hold duration, in seconds
TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalMessagesSent.description_en: Total number of messages sent in chat sessions

TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_en: Total number of messages sent by agents in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_zh: Chat会话中坐席发送的总消息量

TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_en: Total number of messages sent by the customer in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_zh: Chat会话中客户发送的总消息量

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed. (Because the answering event and the acknowledgement event may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases.)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageDialingTime.description_en: Average Dial-up Time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalDialingTime / CallsDialed
AverageDialingTime.description_zh: 平均拨号时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalDialingTime/CallsDialed

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average hold duration, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsAnswered
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsAnswered

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time per call, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsDialed
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/CallsDialed

CallsAttendedTransferred.description_en: Number of attended transfers, which refers to the quantity of calls that underwent attended transfer. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsAttendedTransferred.description_zh: 咨询转接量，即发生咨询转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsBlindTransferred.description_en: Number of blind transfers, which refers to the quantity of calls that underwent blind transfer. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsBlindTransferred.description_zh: 直接转接量，即发生直接转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: Hold Count, which is the number of calls that were placed on hold. If a single call was put on hold multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。若一通电话保持多次，算一次

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang for agents. If a single call is assigned to multiple agents and rings for each, it is counted as one
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，若一通电话分配给多个坐席并产生了振铃，算一次

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum call hold duration, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_en: Maximum post-processing time per call, in seconds
MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction Index, which is the average of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction Rate. Calculation Formula: Number of responses marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AverageBreakTime.description_en: Average break duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalBreakTime / Count of breaks. The count of breaks is not an exposed API field
AverageBreakTime.description_zh: 平均小休时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalBreakTime/小休次数。小休次数为非接口统计字段

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / (InboundCallsHold + OutboundCallsHold)
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/(呼入CallsHold+呼出CallsHold)

AverageReadyTime.description_en: Average ready duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalReadyTime / Count of ready events. The count of ready events is not currently exposed externally
AverageReadyTime.description_zh: 平均就绪时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalReadyTime/就绪次数，就绪次数暂不对外暴露

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / (CallsAnswered + CallsHandled)
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalTalkTime/(CallsAnswered+CallsHandled)

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time per call, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / TotalCalls
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/TotalCalls

MaxBreakTime.description_en: Maximum short break duration, in seconds

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum call hold duration, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxLoggedInAgents.description_en: Maximum number of agents simultaneously logged on during the Time Range
MaxLoggedInAgents.description_zh: 此时间范围内最多同时登录的座席数量

MaxWorkTime.description_en: Maximum post-processing time per call, in seconds
MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

OccupancyRate.description_en: Agent occupancy rate. Calculation Formula: (TotalWorkTime + TotalTalkTime) / TotalLoggedInTime
OccupancyRate.description_zh: 座席利用率，计算公式为： (TotalworkTime + TotalTalkTime ) / TotalLoggedInTime

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Count of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalCalls.description_en: Total call volume. Calculation Formula: CallsOffered + CallsDialed
TotalCalls.description_zh: 总电话量。计算公式为：CallsOffered + CallsDialed

TotalLoggedInTime.description_en: Total logon duration, in seconds. Exclude break time
TotalLoggedInTime.description_zh: 总登录时长，单位秒。不包含小休时长

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒
